response.sql: WITH film_ratios AS (SELECT rating, rental_rate / rental_duration AS ratio FROM film WHERE replacement_cost < 20.99), rating_averages AS (SELECT rating, AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM film_ratios GROUP BY rating), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg FROM rating_averages) SELECT ra.rating, ra.avg_ratio, ra.avg_ratio - om.overall_avg AS difference FROM rating_averages ra CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE om.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND ra.avg_ratio > om.overall_avg ORDER BY ra.rating
